formula_agent.update_text: When the formula references named components (e.g., Operating Income, Revenue), first extract each value from the question by matching exact terms and units before substituting; if a referenced component is missing or ambiguous, state that it cannot be computed rather than guessing.
formula_agent.rationale: This generalizes beyond this trivial case to ensure the agent reliably maps formula variables to provided values and avoids fabricating inputs when data is absent.

formula_agent.update_text: When applying the DDM formula P_0 = D_1 / (r - g), first verify r > g; if r ≤ g, the model is invalid and state so instead of computing. Always express the final answer with exactly 2 decimal places.
formula_agent.rationale: Prevents a silent division-by-zero or negative-price error when the growth rate meets or exceeds the discount rate, which would otherwise produce an undefined or nonsensical result.
